questions.question: Scala nima?
options: JVM da ishlaydigan funksional va ob'ektga yo'naltirilgan dasturlash tili

questions.question: Scala da o'zgaruvchi qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Scala da val va var farqi?
Scala da case class nima?
options: Immutable ma'lumot tashuvchi — equals, hashCode, toString, copy avtomatik

questions.question: Scala da println nima qiladi?
options: Konsolga matn va yangi qator chiqaradi

questions.question: Scala da trait nima?
options: Interfeys + implementatsiya — mixin uchun, ko'p meros mumkin

questions.question: Scala da pattern matching qanday?
options: match/case — Java switch dan kuchliroq, tiplarga ham match qiladi

questions.question: Scala da List nima?
options: Immutable linked list — :: va Nil bilan

questions.question: Scala da Option nima?
options: Some(value) yoki None — null ga xavfsiz alternativa

questions.question: Scala da map nima uchun?
options: Kolleksiya elementlarini transformatsiya qilib yangi kolleksiya qaytaradi

questions.question: Scala da flatMap nima?
options: map + flatten — monadik zanjir uchun, Option, List, Future bilan

questions.question: Scala da for comprehension nima?
options: for { x <- list; y <- ... } yield — flatMap/map zanjirining syntactic sugar

questions.question: Scala da implicit nima?
options: Kompilyator tomonidan avtomatik kiritiluvchi parametr yoki konvertatsiya

questions.question: Scala da Future nima?
options: Asinxron hisoblash natijalari uchun — onComplete, map, flatMap bilan

questions.question: Scala da Akka nima?
options: Actor model asosidagi concurrent va distributed tizimlar uchun toolkit

questions.question: Scala da sealed trait nima?
options: Faqat bir fayldagi klasslar meros olishi — exhaustive pattern matching

questions.question: Scala da type class nima?
options: Ad-hoc polymorphism — implicit parameter orqali funksionallik qo'shish

questions.question: Scala da Either nima?
options: Left (xato) yoki Right (muvaffaqiyat) — xato boshqarish uchun

questions.question: Scala da companion object nima?
options: Klass bilan bir xil nomli object — factory methods, static members

questions.question: Scala da lazy val nima?
options: Birinchi kirishda initsializatsiya — thread-safe, bir marta hisoblanadi

questions.question: Scala da higher kinded types nima?
options: Tip konstruktorlari uchun tip parametrlari — F[_] kabi

questions.question: Scala da cats kutubxonasi nima uchun?
options: Funksional dasturlash tiplar va type class lar — Monad, Functor, Applicative

questions.question: Scala da Try nima?
options: Success(value) yoki Failure(exception) — exception handling funksional uslubda

questions.question: Scala da Stream (LazyList) nima?
options: Lazy infinite ketma-ketliklar — faqat kerakli elementlar hisoblanadi

questions.question: Scala da foldLeft nima uchun?
options: Akkumulyator bilan chapdan o'ngga aylanib bitta qiymat hosil qilish

questions.question: Scala da apply metodi nima?
options: Ob'ektni funksiya kabi chaqirish: MyClass(arg) = MyClass.apply(arg)

questions.question: Scala da unapply nima uchun?
options: Pattern matching uchun extractor — case class avtomatik beradi

questions.question: Scala da given/using (Scala 3) nima?
options: Scala 3 da implicit ga yangi nom — given ta'riflash, using ishlatish

questions.question: Scala da extension methods (Scala 3) nima?
options: extension (x: T) def method() — mavjud tipga metod qo'shish

questions.question: Scala da opaque types (Scala 3) nima?
options: Wrapper overhead holda yangi tip — type alias lekin tashqariga yashirin

questions.question: Scala da enum (Scala 3) nima?
options: Kuchli enum — sealed hierarchy alternativa, parameters, methods

questions.question: Scala da union types (Scala 3) nima?
options: A | B — qiymat A yoki B tipida bo'lishi mumkin

questions.question: Scala da monad transformer nima?
options: Ko'p monad qatlamlarini birlashtirish — OptionT, EitherT — cats kutubxonasi

questions.question: Scala da tagless final nima?
options: Algebraic effect lar uchun dizayn namunasi — F[_] type parameter bilan abstraktsiya

questions.question: Scala da ZIO nima?
options: Pure functional effects library — ZIO[R, E, A] — environment, error, success

questions.question: Scala da Macro nima?
options: Kompilyatsiya vaqtida kod transformatsiya va generatsiya — inline def

questions.question: Scala da filter nima?
options: Shartga mos elementlardan yangi kolleksiya yaratadi

questions.question: Scala da structural types nima?
options: Nominal emas, struktural mos kelish — { def method(): Type } kabi

questions.question: Scala da fs2 (Functional Streams for Scala) nima?
options: Pure funksional streaming kutubxona — back-pressure, resource safety

questions.question: Scala da http4s nima?
options: Pure funksional HTTP server va client — cats-effect bilan

questions.question: Scala da Doobie nima?
options: Pure funksional JDBC layer — SQL so'rovlar type-safe tarzda

questions.question: Scala da implicit conversion nima?
options: Tip A ni B ga avtomatik aylantirish — implicit def a2b(a: A): B

questions.question: Scala da type lambda nima?
options: Partial type application — ({type L[x] = Either[String, x]})#L yoki Scala 3 da [x] =>> F[x]

questions.question: Scala da phantom types nima?
options: Tip parametr runtime ma'lumot emas, compile-time constraint uchun — state machine encoding

questions.question: Scala da Algebird nima?
options: Twitter — abstract algebra: Monoid, Group, Ring — distributed aggregation

questions.question: Scala da Discipline nima?
options: cats kutubxona uchun algebra qonunlarini test qiluvchi framework

questions.question: Scala da Shapeless nima?
options: Generic programming — HList, Coproduct, automatic derivation
